mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, compressing the cost of capital and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines continuously over 3 months across any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in the prior month across any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5pp in 3 months with CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), higher real rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 2.5
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 2.5 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average across any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales decline (RSAFS) below $375 billion signals weak consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 375000.0 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) combined with stable federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals tight monetary policy amid strong labor conditions, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS change < 0.2pp in the prior month across any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock (INDPRO declining below 110.0) reduces economic output and increases inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0 over any 5-year rolling window.
